problems: The square reuses the pale flag paving of the Bronze and Middle Ages. Only the clock, tram and gas lamps signal the Industrial Age.
elements.fix: Use surveyed granite setts laid in straight bands with a dressed granite or blue-brick border. Add cast-iron drain grates and coal-hole covers, and light soot staining that gets darker near the tram street.

problems: The whole claimed lot is paved in bright red brick, so a home yard looks like a brick plaza. It is also the most saturated ground on the board and competes with the house.
elements.fix: Make the lot a front garden/yard of earth and grass with a gravel path. Keep the brick only as a low boundary wall under the iron railings, plus a brick step or path to the door.
